rationale: DesignIR parsing skips three more design-tool rules when the IR's source adapter is browser-capture: separator promotion (a measured sub-half-pixel stroked box keeps its width and border), rounded-corner inheritance (a measured child keeps its own radius), and name-based audio-widget detection (a capture's unbound div named like a control stays a frame; capture-bound controls are explicit). Design-tool IR is unchanged, and connector spanning is untouched because a capture never writes a row-direction node. A new lens-calibration fixture (21-design-tool-heuristics) lays out each trigger. Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
